newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Pepsi to invest $400 mln in Venezuela over 3 years.
newsitem.headline: Pepsi to invest $400 mln in Venezuela over 3 years.

text.p: PepsiCo will invest $400 million in Venezuela over the next three years in an effort to re-coup the leading market position it lost in August when local bottler Oswaldo Cisneros switched to Coca-Cola Co, Pepsi said.
"We'll be back soon," regional Pepsi president Alberto Uribe told reporters. "We're working hard at it."

Pepsi's Venezuelan market share topped 80 percent before the Cisneros bottling company Embotelladora de Venezuela moved to Coca-Cola on August 16. The change-over left the New York based soft drinks giant without an effective local distribution system.
Uribe said Pepsi would be producing again in Venezuela within the next six months -- although it would take "two years to return to the levels we enjoyed before."
He declined to comment on local reports that Pepsi may finally team up with Venezuela's powerful Polar beer company.
